resources.string: Select a text in any app and choose "SubRead Anki" in the menu. A pop-up shows the terms at the word, the same as a dictionary. A tap on another character moves the word. Tap "＋ Anki": the card gets the word, its reading and definition, the sentence, a picture of the screen and the sound of the sentence.
Nothing leaves the device. The app talks to AnkiDroid and SubRead Dictionary on the device. It opens a URL only when a sender gives one for an audio or a picture.
AnkiDroid is not installed. The app adds the cards to it.
Allow the app to add cards to AnkiDroid. If AnkiDroid refuses, turn on "Enable AnkiDroid API" in its settings, under Advanced.
The name of the new deck
Note type: %1$s (the app makes it in AnkiDroid)
What goes into each field of the note type. The app guesses from the names; Lapis and the basic note types work as they are.
SubRead Dictionary gives the terms of the pop-up: the reading, the definition and the word audio.
SubRead Dictionary is installed, but this version does not answer other apps. Update it for the definitions.
SubRead Dictionary is not installed. Without it, the pop-up has no definitions: the word goes on the card as it is.

While the capture is on, each card gets a picture of the screen and the sound of the last seconds before the text was selected: the audiobook that you listen to while you read. A clip of silence is left out. Android asks each time the capture starts. The quick settings have a tile for it.
With SubRead Overlay, a tap on a subtitle word shows its line in the pop-up, and the sound of that line goes on the card.
This Android version captures the screen only; the sound of other apps needs Android 10.
Capturing the sound and the screen for the cards
Android did not allow the capture.
The capture needs the microphone permission of Android, for the sound of the player. No microphone is recorded.
Sound before and after a subtitle line, in milliseconds
A selected text: show the pop-up
A selected text: add the first term at once, with no pop-up
A word that is in the deck already: skip
A word that is in the deck already: add again
No term here. Tap another character, or add the word as it is.
No dictionary: install SubRead Dictionary for the reading and the definition. The word goes on the card as it is.
Capture off: no picture, no sound
The request is empty: no word and no sentence.
Anki did not take the card: %1$s
Picture added to the last card
No card of the last hour to add the picture to
